hero.title: Software and AI that knows your business.
hero.subtitle:
We design and build custom software, automate your processes, and connect Claude to your systems.
Less admin, more time for what matters.

items.question: Who has owed us money for over 30 days?
items.answer: Three partners, €3,100 in total. The largest is €1,520, overdue by 47 days. Should I draft a friendly reminder for each?

items.question: What do customers often buy together?
items.answer: The ceramic mug and the coffee beans share a basket in 38% of orders. A bundle could work well.

services.label: Services
services.title: How we help
services.subtitle: We start with one well-defined task, where it saves you the most time. Most projects combine two or three of these.

ai.title: AI integration with Claude
ai.description: Claude takes over the repetitive work: processes invoices, sorts email, answers customers, and picks up the phone if you need it to.

software.title: Custom business software
software.description: Customer records, inventory, production tracking, partner portals. Built for how you actually work, not the other way around.

automation.title: Process automation and AI agents
automation.description: Incoming invoices, emails, and documents land where they belong on their own. A person still approves anything important.

web.title: Websites and webshops
web.description: A fast, custom-designed site or webshop, connected to the systems behind it. Ready in days.

training.title: AI training for teams
training.description: Hands-on Claude workshops built on your own tasks. No technical background needed.

audit.title: AI assessment
audit.description: We map your workflows and show where AI saves real time and where it isn't worth it. You get a written plan.

ai.label: AI integration
ai.title: Claude works in the background.
ai.subtitle: We put Claude where the manual work piles up: from incoming invoices to customer questions and phone calls.

automations.label: A few examples of what it can take off your plate

invoices.title: Invoices and documents
invoices.description: Claude reads incoming PDF invoices and delivery notes, and checks amounts and due dates. At month end it sends them to your accountant as one tidy package.
invoices.example: At month end, Claude collects the invoices that came in, checks their details, and sends them to your accountant as one tidy package.

chase.title: Reminders
chase.description: On a schedule, it watches overdue invoices, unanswered quotes and expiring contracts. It writes a personal message for each, which you approve.
chase.example: Three invoices went overdue this week. Claude drafts a personal reminder for each, you approve, and they're sent.

inbox.title: Inbox triage
inbox.description: Reads, labels and routes incoming email to the right colleague. It drafts replies based on earlier threads and your company documents.
inbox.example: A customer asks about delivery times. Claude routes the email to the right colleague, with a draft reply attached.

reports.title: Morning brief
reports.description: Every morning it collects the numbers from your invoicing system and spreadsheets and sends a short brief to Slack or email. Anything unusual is highlighted.
reports.example: At 8 am a short brief is waiting: yesterday's revenue, overdue invoices and today's to-dos. You can ask it questions too.

support.title: Customer service assistant
support.description: Answers instantly on your website and WhatsApp, using your own knowledge base and webshop data. When it's not sure, it hands the case to your team.
support.example: At 10 pm a customer asks where their order is. Claude checks the webshop and answers right away: it arrives tomorrow.

voice.title: Phone assistant
voice.description: Answers the phone in a natural voice, Claude understands the request, and books a free slot in your calendar. After every call you get a summary of the conversation.
voice.example: A call comes in over lunch, when nobody's free. The assistant picks up in Hungarian, books an appointment, and emails you a summary.

leads.title: Leads and quotes
leads.description: Replies to new inquiries within minutes, logs them in your CRM, and drafts a quote from your price list. It can book a call too.
leads.example: An inquiry arrives for a large order. Within minutes there's a draft quote based on your price list, ready for you to check.

content.title: Content in your voice
content.description: Writes product descriptions, posts and newsletters in your voice, in Hungarian, English and German. It prepares visuals in Canva and uploads copy to your webshop.
content.example: You add 50 new products. The descriptions are done in an afternoon, in three languages, in your company's style.

process.title: Clear steps, no surprises.
process.subtitle: We don't experiment with your money. We start with an assessment, begin with one small, well-defined task, and only build on what works.

plan.title: Written plan, fixed price

build.title: Built in short rounds
build.body: You see working results week by week and can steer as we go. Nothing goes live untested.

run.title: Handover and operation
run.body: We train your team, hand over full documentation, and look after the system for a monthly fee.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what personal data we collect, how we use it, and how we keep it safe.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.content:
Budapest Labs (see Imprint for full business details).
Email: hello@budapestlabs.com

collection.title: What we collect
collection.content: When you fill out our contact form, we receive: your name, email address, phone number (if you choose to share it), business name (optional), the service you're interested in, and your message. That's it. You can also write to us directly at hello@budapestlabs.com. We don't use cookies, tracking scripts, or analytics tools of any kind.

basis.title: Why we're allowed to use it
basis.content: We handle your data because you chose to send it to us. That's your consent under EU data protection law (GDPR). If we start working together, we also need your details to deliver the project. In some cases, we may keep records to meet legal or accounting requirements.

purpose.title: What we do with it
purpose.content: We use your contact details only to get back to you, put together a proposal, and deliver your project. We will never sell, rent, or share your information with anyone for marketing or any unrelated purpose.

storage.title: How we keep it safe
storage.content: Your data is stored on encrypted servers within the European Union. Invoices and accounting records are kept for 8 years as required by Hungarian accounting law (Act C of 2000, §169). Other business correspondence and project data is kept for the duration of our working relationship, plus up to 5 years afterwards. After that, it's permanently deleted.

thirdparty.title: Services we rely on
thirdparty.content: Our website is hosted on Vercel (vercel.com), and we use Resend (resend.com) to deliver emails from our contact form. Both providers process data on our behalf under GDPR-compliant agreements. All connections use HTTPS encryption. Vercel keeps standard server logs (IP address, timestamp, page visited), which are automatically deleted after 30 days. Your information is never shared with anyone else.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.content: Under EU law (GDPR), you can: ask to see what data we have about you; correct anything that's wrong; ask us to delete your data; limit or object to how we use it; or request a copy in a portable format. You can also withdraw your consent at any time. This won't affect anything we did before the withdrawal. Just email us at hello@budapestlabs.com and we'll get back to you within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These are the terms that apply when you work with Budapest Labs. We've kept them straightforward. No surprises.

provider.title: Service provider
provider.content:
Budapest Labs (see Imprint for full business details).
Email: hello@budapestlabs.com

scope.title: What we do
scope.content: We design, build, and operate custom software, AI integrations (for example connecting your systems to Claude), automations, websites, and webshops. We also run AI training and assessments. The exact scope of each project is set out in a written offer or contract before work begins.

payment.title: How payment works
payment.content: We don't publish prices on our website. Every project is quoted individually. The scope, price, payment schedule, and any monthly operation fee are fixed in a written offer or contract before work begins, and the contract terms apply. Larger projects are split into phases, each with its own fixed price. Ongoing operation and maintenance are billed monthly, as agreed in the contract. We accept bank transfer, Revolut, and cash. You will receive a proper invoice for every payment, issued in accordance with Hungarian law.

revisions.title: Feedback and changes
revisions.content: Each phase includes the feedback rounds set out in your offer. If you'd like something outside the agreed scope, we tell you the cost before we do it. No surprises.

delivery.title: Timelines
delivery.content: Timelines are agreed for each project and phase. They are estimates based on the agreed scope, and they depend on how quickly we receive the access, content, and feedback we need from you. Delays on your side don't count against our timeline.

client.title: What we need from you
client.content: We need access to the systems we work with, the content and information the project needs, and timely feedback. Please make sure you have the right to share everything you provide. Where we process personal data on your behalf, we sign a separate data processing agreement.

ownership.title: Who owns what
ownership.content: Once paid, what we build for you is yours: the code, the documentation, and all access. We may reuse general-purpose tools and code that aren't specific to your project. We'd love to mention your project in our references, but only with your permission.

thirdparty.title: Third-party services
thirdparty.content: Projects may rely on third-party services such as Claude, hosting, invoicing, or webshop platforms. We help set them up, but they are independent services with their own terms and fees, usually on your own account.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.content: You can stop a project between phases and pay only for the phases already completed. Monthly operation can be cancelled as set out in your contract, and we help you hand everything over. On our side, if we can't reach you for over 30 days, we may pause or close the project.

warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.content:
If something we built doesn't work as agreed, we fix it free of charge within the warranty period set in your contract. While we operate a system for a monthly fee, fixes are always included.

Not covered: new features, changes in scope, or issues caused by changes made by you or a third party. Third-party services (AI providers, hosting, invoicing or webshop platforms) are outside our control.

liability.title: Our responsibility
liability.content: Our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the project. We're not responsible for issues caused by changes you make after delivery, or for third-party service outages.

law.title: Legal details
law.content: These terms follow Hungarian law. If there's ever a disagreement, we'd prefer to work it out together first. Consumer complaints may also be directed to the competent conciliation body. If the dispute cannot be resolved otherwise, the Buda Central District Court or, depending on jurisdiction, the Budapest Capital Regional Court shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
